$metadata.description: Extract financial data from 10-K annual reports

quality_checks.message: Filing date must be valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format

title: SEC 10-K Filing Extraction Schema
description: Extract structured financial data from SEC 10-K annual reports. SCOPE: Income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements. EXCLUDE: Footnotes, management discussion, risk factors.

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK) - unique SEC identifier

company_name.description: Official company name exactly as written

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol. Null if not publicly traded.

business_description.description: Brief description of business. Null if not provided.

filing_date.description: Date filed with SEC in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if not stated.

period_end.description: Fiscal year end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if not stated.

form_type.description: Form type (e.g., '10-K', '10-K/A'). Null if not stated.

financial_statements.description: Financial statement line items. One entry per statement type (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).

revenue.description: Total revenue/sales in dollars. Null if not applicable.

cost_of_revenue.description: Cost of goods sold in dollars. Null if not applicable.

gross_profit.description: Gross profit in dollars. Null if not applicable.

operating_expenses.description: Total operating expenses in dollars. Null if not applicable.

operating_income.description: Operating income in dollars. Null if not applicable.

net_income.description: Net income/loss in dollars. Null if not applicable.

total_assets.description: Total assets in dollars. Null if not applicable.

total_liabilities.description: Total liabilities in dollars. Null if not applicable.

shareholders_equity.description: Total shareholders' equity in dollars. Null if not applicable.

operating_cash_flow.description: Cash flow from operations in dollars. Null if not applicable.

investing_cash_flow.description: Cash flow from investing in dollars. Null if not applicable.

financing_cash_flow.description: Cash flow from financing in dollars. Null if not applicable.

earnings_per_share.description: Basic earnings per share. Null if not applicable.

notes.description: Additional context or notes. Null if none.
